drilling_events.description: Differential pipe sticking across sticky montmorillonite clay after 3 hours stationary drill string during directional survey. Overpull exceeded 110,000 lbs. Mud weight was 10.9 ppg with excessive filter cake (8/32").
drilling_events.mitigation: Spotted 50 bbl OBM lubricant soak pill weighted to 11.0 ppg with 4% pipe-release surfactant. Soak time 12 hrs. String jarred free. Total NPT: 14 days incl. fishing. Recommendation: maintain >60 RPM rotation in Girujan, never allow stationary string >5 min.

drilling_events.description: Sudden loss of returns (60 bbl/hr) upon penetrating micro-fractured porous Tipam sandstone TS-3 interval. Active pit volume dropped by 38 bbl.
drilling_events.mitigation: Pulled off bottom to 2,500m. Spotted 25 bbl coarse CaCO3 (30 ppb) + medium Mica (15 ppb) LCM pill. Squeezed at 250 psi annular pressure. Reduced MW from 11.2 to 10.4 ppg. Full circulation restored. Recommendation: maintain MW within 10.2–10.6 ppg window in Tipam TS-3.

drilling_events.description: Unpredicted pore pressure surge in Barail carbonaceous coal-shale sequence. Pit volume gained 22 bbl in 4 minutes. Standpipe pressure flutter +180 psi. Background gas jumped from 25 to 340 units.
drilling_events.mitigation: Shut in well via annular BOP per OISD-STD-174. Circulated out kick using Wait & Weight method with 12.8 ppg kill mud. Total well control event duration: 30 days including kill verification and cement squeeze.

drilling_events.description: Drill string dragged heavily during connection at 1,720m in Girujan Clay. Immediate spotting of lubricant pill prevented severe sticking.
drilling_events.mitigation: Spotted OBM lubricant pill, maintained rotation at 60 RPM, successfully freed in 6 hours. Adjusted MW from 10.5 to 10.8 ppg for the remaining Girujan interval.

drilling_events.description: Well kicked and blew out on 27-May-2020 during workover to recomplete from Langpar (3,870m) to Lakadong/Therria (3,729–3,739m). Root cause: premature BOP removal before establishing adequate mechanical barriers. Single cement plug placed at shallow ~1,000m in deviated section instead of above production packer (~3,700m). Gas ignited on 9-Jun-2020. Well killed by snubbing unit (Alert Disaster Control, Singapore) on 15-Nov-2020. Permanently P&A on 3-Dec-2020 (190 days).
drilling_events.mitigation: Specialized snubbing unit mobilized from Alert Disaster Control (Singapore) and Schlumberger. Heavy kill mud pumped via snubbing string. Well permanently plugged and abandoned. NGT Katakey Committee: ensure BOP is never removed without verified dual mechanical barriers.

drilling_events.description: Partial loss of returns (40 bbl/hr) in Tipam TS-3 thief zone. Similar loss pattern to NHK-162 event in same stratigraphic interval.
drilling_events.mitigation: Spotted 20 bbl coarse CaCO3 + mica LCM pill. Reduced MW to 10.4 ppg. Losses stopped after 2 pills. Drilled ahead with maintained 10.4 ppg to Tipam base.

drilling_events.description: Gas influx at 3,380m in lower Barail coal-shale sequence. Pit gain 18 bbl. SPP increased by 140 psi. Connection gas rose to 280 units.
drilling_events.mitigation: Shut in on annular BOP per OISD-STD-174. Wait & Weight kill with 11.2 ppg mud. Kill verification over 3 circulations. Total event: 8 days. Casing shoe integrity confirmed with LOT.

drilling_events.description: Severe coal cavings from Tikak Parbat coal seams at 3,150–3,180m. Annulus packed off during POOH. Torque spikes to 22,000 ft-lbs.
drilling_events.mitigation: Circulated clean with high-vis sweeps (30 bbl each, 3 sweeps). Increased MW to 11.0 ppg for better borehole stability. Wiper trips every 50m drilled. Recommendation: maintain inhibitive KCl-polymer mud system in Barail coal intervals.

drilling_events.description: Severe borehole breakout and cavings in Kopili reactive shales at 3,780m. Hole enlarged from 8.5" to 14". Caliper log confirmed 65% hole enlargement. Narrow MW window (10.15–10.8 ppg) with pore pressure at 9.9 ppg.
drilling_events.mitigation: Increased MW to 10.8 ppg (approaching fracture gradient at 13.8 ppg). Ran cement squeeze to stabilize worst intervals. Set 7" liner from 3,100m to 3,820m. Recommendation: set 9-5/8" casing shoe deep into Kopili per Kumar & Talreja (2018) geomech study.

drilling_events.description: Severe pore pressure ramp crossing into Kopili Formation. Pore pressure rose from 63 pcf to 74 pcf (8.42 to 9.9 ppg) as predicted by Dasgupta et al. (2019). Pit gain 15 bbl. MW had to be increased from 10.4 to 12.3 ppg.
drilling_events.mitigation: Shut in per OISD-STD-174. Killed with 12.3 ppg weighted mud. Set 7" liner at 3,650m shoe before resuming. Total NPT: 10 days. Lesson: mandatory pre-drill geomechanical model for any Kopili penetration.

drilling_events.description: Gas influx at 3,220m in Barail sandstone-coal transition. Pit gain 12 bbl over 8 minutes. Background gas surged from 15 to 220 units. SPP flutter +120 psi.
drilling_events.mitigation: Shut in per ONGC SOP. Driller's Method kill with 11.0 ppg mud. Gas circulated out over 2 bottoms-up. Kill verified over 24 hrs static observation.

drilling_events.description: Differential sticking at 1,720m in Girujan Clay during pipe connection. String stationary for 8 minutes due to equipment malfunction. Overpull 95,000 lbs could not free string.
drilling_events.mitigation: Spotted 40 bbl OBM soak pill with surfactant. Jarred for 3 days without success. Back-off attempted at 1,710m. Sidetracked with whipstock at 1,680m. Total fishing + sidetrack: 8 days. Lesson learned: never exceed 5 min stationary time in Girujan.

drilling_events.description: Severe bit balling in reactive Girujan clay at 1,850m. ROP dropped from 12 m/hr to 1.5 m/hr. PDC bit cutters completely packed with clay. Torque erratic between 8,000 and 18,000 ft-lbs.
drilling_events.mitigation: POOH to change bit. Ran polycrystalline insert bit with anti-balling coating. Added 5% KCl to mud system for clay inhibition. ROP recovered to 10 m/hr.

drilling_events.description: Shallow gas pocket encountered at 180m in Dihing Formation gravels. Mud returns became gas-cut (gas units spiked to 450). Minor flow observed at wellhead.
drilling_events.mitigation: Increased pump rate to circulate out gas. Raised MW from 9.5 to 9.8 ppg. Gas dissipated after 3 bottoms-up circulations. Conductor set at 200m with cement to surface.

drilling_events.description: Progressive seepage losses escalating to 45 bbl/hr across Tipam TS-3 to TS-5 interval (2,450–2,600m). Three LCM pills required before losses were controlled.
drilling_events.mitigation: Pill 1: 25 bbl coarse CaCO3. Reduced losses to 20 bbl/hr. Pill 2: 30 bbl CaCO3 + mica + cellophane flakes. Reduced to 5 bbl/hr. Pill 3: 20 bbl fine-medium CaCO3 sealer. Full returns restored. Reduced MW from 10.6 to 10.3 ppg.
Pump 25 bbl coarse calcium carbonate (CaCO3) + mica pill. Regulate MW < 10.8 ppg.

documents.raw_excerpt:
SECTION 8: OPERATIONAL INCIDENTS (Page 147)
DATE: 04-MAY-2018 | DEPTH: 1,680m MD | FORMATION: Girujan Clay
Differential pipe sticking across sticky montmorillonite clay. Spotted 50 bbl OBM lubricant pill. Jarred free after 14 days.
DDR Summary: Severe lost circulation at 2,540m MD in Tipam Sandstone TS-3. Spotted 25 bbl coarse CaCO3 pill with mica. Reduced MW to 10.4 ppg. Full returns restored.
Day 14: Drilled from 1,680m to 1,740m. Sticking observed at 1,720m in Girujan Clay. Spotted OBM pill, freed in 6 hrs. Rotation maintained at 60 RPM.
Gas influx at 3,380m MD in Barail Group. Pit volume gained 22 bbl in 4 min. Well shut in on annular BOP per OISD-STD-174. Wait & Weight kill executed with 12.8 ppg mud.

ROOT CAUSE: Premature removal of BOP before establishing dual mechanical barriers. Single cement plug at ~1,000m in deviated section. Gas column from Lakadong (3,729–3,739m) overcame shallow plug. Well control capability: ZERO at time of kick.
Gas kick at 3,380m in lower Barail coal-shale. Pit gain 18 bbl. SPP +140 psi. Wait & Weight kill with 11.2 ppg. Kill verified over 3 circulations.
Severe borehole breakout in Kopili at 3,780m. Hole enlarged 8.5" to 14" (65% enlargement). Narrow MW window 10.15–10.8 ppg. Liner set 3,100m–3,820m.
AAPG #42308: Reducing Drilling Risks in J bend Wells Targeting Basement in Tectonic Area through Geomechanical Solutions. Tipam/Barail MW: 70–73 pcf. Kopili MW: 76–81 pcf at 30° deviation.
Differential sticking at 1,720m in Girujan Clay. String stationary 8 min during equipment malfunction. Overpull 95,000 lbs. Sidetracked with whipstock at 1,680m after 8 days total.
Gas influx at 3,220m in Barail. Pit gain 12 bbl over 8 min. Background gas from 15 to 220 units. Driller's Method kill with 11.0 ppg.
Kopili overpressure at 3,850m. PP jumped from 63 to 74 pcf (8.42 to 9.9 ppg). Pit gain 15 bbl. MW increased from 10.4 to 12.3 ppg. Liner set at 3,650m.
Progressive seepage losses across Tipam TS-3 to TS-5 (2,450–2,600m). Three LCM pills required. MW reduced from 10.6 to 10.3 ppg.

alerts.title: Approaching 2,450m — Barail Gas Precursor Horizon
alerts.description: Offset well BAGHJAN-5 (13.2 km NE) encountered severe gas influx with 22 bbl pit volume gain at 3,380m MD in Barail carbonaceous sand. BAGHJAN-9 confirmed same hazard at 3,380m. Current bit at 2,418m — 32m above historical precursor horizon.
alerts.recommended_action: 1. Check trip tank & flow sensor calibration. 2. Prepare 12.8 ppg kill mud in reserve pit. 3. Perform remote BOP choke drill per OISD-STD-174. 4. Review Baghjan-5 EVT-03 mitigation: Wait & Weight kill procedure.
alerts.action_taken: Executed DIFFERENTIAL PIPE STICKING SOP (GIRUJAN CLAY) on OIL-RIG-04 (Moran-29) at depth 2395.0m MD

alerts.title: ROP Deviation vs. Offset Well Benchmark
alerts.description: Current ROP (6.8 m/hr) is 18% below NHK-162 benchmark (8.3 m/hr) in lower Barail sandstone-shale sequence at equivalent depth.
alerts.recommended_action: Inspect bit dull grading upon next trip; consider increasing WOB from 18.5 to 22 klbs. Review NHK-162 drilling parameters for Barail interval optimization.
alerts.action_taken: Adjusted WOB to 21 klbs, ROP improved to 7.6 m/hr.

alerts.title: Kopili Overpressure Zone Approach — 600m Remaining
alerts.description: NHK-561 is at 3,100m MD drilling towards target 3,800m. Kopili Formation expected at 3,700m. Offset well NHK-656 encountered severe borehole breakout at 3,780m. BGH-21 required MW increase to 12.3 ppg.
alerts.recommended_action: 1. Pre-drill geomechanical model mandatory before Kopili entry. 2. Prepare weighted kill mud (12.0 ppg). 3. Plan 7" liner setting depth at 3,650m shoe. 4. Review NHK-656 EVT-09 and BGH-21 EVT-10 mitigations.

alerts.title: Girujan Clay Interval Transit Complete — Lessons Logged
alerts.description: MOR-29 successfully transited Girujan Clay (1,500–2,200m) with minor sticking at 1,720m (EVT-04). Total Girujan NPT: 6 hrs vs. 336 hrs for MOR-07.
alerts.recommended_action: Log completion: KCl-polymer mud system effective. Maintain >60 RPM rotation policy in Girujan intervals for future wells.
alerts.action_taken: Girujan lessons documented in well file. Rotation policy confirmed for remaining wells.

alerts.title: Tipam Lost Circulation Risk — Approaching TS-3 Thief Zone
alerts.description: MOR-29 approaching Tipam TS-3 interval (~2,450m) where offset wells MOR-12 and HGJ-48 experienced 40–60 bbl/hr losses. NHK-162 lost 38 bbl active volume at 2,540m in same unit.
alerts.recommended_action: 1. Pre-mix 30 bbl coarse CaCO3 + mica LCM pill in slug tank. 2. Maintain MW at 10.4–10.6 ppg (not >10.8 ppg to avoid fracture propagation). 3. Monitor pit volume continuously through TS-3.

alerts.title: Active Well Control Event — Rudrasagar-147 Gas Leak
alerts.description: Uncontrolled gas leak during workover on Rudrasagar-147. Well control unit mobilized. This alert is for fleet awareness — no action required at your rig.
alerts.recommended_action: Fleet awareness only. Monitor OIL safety bulletin channel. Ensure BOP equipment on all active wells has passed recent function test.
alerts.action_taken: Well control unit from Cudd Energy capped the well. All BOP function tests verified across fleet.
